answer: A chain-continuity bond blocks bulk fakes: each identity keeps one unbroken history. Each applicant locks 55 credits and each epoch submits a fresh link derived from its prior answer, so links flow into a river log. A falcon checker replays each link against its key and rejects mismatches. A missing or copied link leaves a hollow gap, burns the bond, and voids rewards. The kth fake still needs its own bond plus a 25-credit fresh link, so 1,000 fakes cost 80,000 credits, with no discount or reuse. An honest agent pays 80 once. Rented chains fail because a rented link replays as a duplicate.
